name: Report_Query
query:
SELECT
    name AS "ID:Link/Member:120",
    member_name AS "Member Name:Data:150",
    email AS "Email:Data:180",
    phone AS "Phone:Phone:120",
    address AS "Address:Small Text:150",
    membership_type AS "Membership Type:Select:140",
    join_date AS "Join Date:Date:110",
    expiry_date AS "Expiry Date:Date:110",
    status AS "Status:Select:100"
FROM
    `tabMember`
WHERE
    status = %(status)s
